title: LRU eviction of leaves
goal:
Add the eviction policy of Section 3 to the radix cache.

The starter gives you a `RadixCache` whose `insert` stamps every node on the path with a clock value, `last_access`, and whose `lock(tokens)` and `unlock(tokens)` add and remove one reference (`ref`) on every node of a stored request. Write one method:

- `evict(num_tokens)` frees at least `num_tokens` tokens and returns how many it freed. Repeat the following until you have freed enough: among the nodes that are not the root, have no children, and have `ref == 0`, remove the one with the smallest `last_access`. A node goes whole, so you can free more than you asked for. When no node can go, stop and return what you freed so far.

A parent that loses its last child becomes a leaf and can go in a later round. The tests check that locked requests survive and that no subtree is dropped.
hints: `self._nodes()` yields every node. Filter it with `n is not self.root and not n.children and n.ref == 0`.
Pick the victim with `min(leaves, key=lambda n: n.last_access)`. Recompute the list of leaves in every round, because a removal can create a new leaf.
To remove a node, delete it from its parent: `del victim.parent.children[victim.edge[0]]`. Add `len(victim.edge)` to `freed`.
Stop with `break` when the list of leaves is empty. Then the loop cannot hang when everything left is locked.
